# Third-party theme palette notices

This repository vendors typed hex tables derived from the following open-source
color palettes for the Learning Tree Theme Recipe System (TASK-007).

Source modules under `src/ui/theme/palettes/` cite this file.

---

- Project: Rosé Pine palette
- Source: https://github.com/rose-pine/palette
